# CALIBER

> MLflow-integrated control plane for building, evaluating, calibrating, governing, and observing trusted agentic workflows — prompts, tools, skills, MCP servers, workflows, knowledge bases, and the Aria copilot — in embedded-plugin or standalone-service topologies.

The pages below are the published architecture, workflow, and strategy documentation. Each link is a flattened Markdown copy built for programmatic access.

## Platform

- [Layered architecture](m-00-layered-architecture.md): The six-layer platform stack, abstract lifecycle chain, governed-asset anatomy, per-family guarantees, deployment topologies, state ownership, trust boundaries, and extension seams.
- [Platform](m-01-platform.md): Boot and dependency graph, embedded-or-standalone topology choice, shared runtime state, async workers, and the trust boundary the whole product stands on.
- [The refinement loop](m-00-refinement-loop.md): The canonical prompt-refinement path — verify, diagnose, optimize, evaluate, review/apply, and durable release — plus the evidence and recovery boundaries that differ across other asset families. Read this first.

## Authoring

- [Prompts](m-02-prompts.md): Non-live MLflow Prompt Registry authoring, render/test history, hidden runtime targets, queued optimizer-backed calibration, and durable alias release/reconciliation.
- [Tools](m-03-tools.md): Versioned callable registry, bounded subprocess test runs, fixture suites and baselines, and deterministic replay calibration.
- [Skills](m-04-skills.md): Reusable instruction assets with packaging, render/selection tests, deterministic runtime selection, and agent-free calibration.
- [MCP servers](m-05-mcp.md): Managed MCP server definitions, transport-aware configuration, connection tests, discovered tool inventories, and policy-managed remote tool use.
- [Workflows](m-06-workflows.md): Manifest authoring, compile/preview/run, versioning and deployments, queued runtime execution, checkpoints, and workflow-as-a-service.
- [Workflow components](m-06-workflows-components.md): The building blocks of a workflow: component anatomy, the typed data-type port system, adding/configuring/connecting/coding/running nodes, and a complete reference for all 31 built-in components.

## Data & knowledge

- [Object store](m-07-object-store.md): MinIO/S3 console and the storage substrate behind uploads, previews, extraction, and artifact browsing.
- [Knowledge bases](m-08-knowledge-bases.md): Versioned RAG corpora with ingestion, chunking, embeddings, Apache AGE graph extraction, hybrid retrieval, pgvector ANN + cross-encoder reranking at scale, and calibration.

## Quality & trust

- [Test sets](m-11-test-sets.md): Versioned evaluation datasets with a hand-curation row editor, trace-to-example capture, MLflow GenAI dataset sync, and the shared evidence base for scoring.
- [Evaluation](m-14-evaluation.md): Dataset scorecards with selectable custom LLM judges, artifact-targeted runs (prompt/skill), a judge playground + human-alignment (agreement/kappa), per-example results, and fail-closed evaluation.
- [Calibration](m-15-calibration.md): Asset-specific evidence loops: provider-and-EvalProvider refinement for prompts and skills, manifest replay for workflows, and revision-fenced deterministic tool suites inline or queued.

## Operations

- [Observability](m-09-observability.md): MLflow traces, feedback, Prometheus metrics, SSE, durable SLO incidents, webhook settlement/dead letters, service visibility, and trace retention.
- [Gateways](m-10-gateways.md): External MLflow AI Gateway discovery, governed guardrail configuration, trace-derived usage, per-model pricing, and CALIBER routing visibility.
- [QA plan](m-13-qa-plan.md): Runtime QA state, runtime approvals, engineering validation suites, and the merged Allure evidence model.
- [Operations runbook](m-19-runbook.md): The on-call procedure for recoveries CALIBER cannot complete alone — an unsettled release intent, an indeterminate external effect, a queue that stopped draining, a lost at-most-once job, and rollback whose semantics differ per asset family — plus what each triage surface does not prove.

## Aria assistant

- [Overview](m-12-assistant.md): Aria's session model, the permissioned agentic tool loop, interaction and approval modes, governed drafts, and transparent execution.

## SDK

- [Python SDK guide](m-20-sdk-guide.md): Install, authenticate, scope to a project, and call the management API from Python — with every snippet taken from the executable examples the SDK test suite runs.
- [Python SDK reference](m-21-sdk-reference.md): Every GA resource module the client exposes, the models they decode into, error types, waiters, and the stability tier each surface carries.

## Strategy & roadmap

- [Competitive analysis](m-17-competitive-analysis.md): How CALIBER compares to Langflow, Flowise, Dify, n8n, Flowable, the LLMOps/eval tools, MLflow GenAI, and the AWS/Google/Microsoft cloud stacks — strengths, weaknesses, and the defensible wedge, with every competitor claim grounded in primary sources.
- [Roadmap](m-18-roadmap.md): The feasibility-grounded, quarter-by-quarter plan derived from the competitive analysis and verified against the architecture — themes, deliverables, ownership, and the adversarial feasibility review.
